locale/list#

Lists in words: "tea, milk and bread", "tea, milk ou bread".

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

LocalizedList(values: ["tea", "milk", "bread"], locale: Locale("en"), kind: ListKind.conjunction, style: ListStyle.long).string();
// "tea, milk, and bread"

Description#

Lists in words: "tea, milk and bread", "tea, milk ou bread".
